description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map5: the sewers (map5_s00), the Resort Area (map5_s01), Annie's Bar and the Indian Runner (map5_s02) and Norman's Motel (map5_s03), with Kaufmann's side story: keys, doors, cutscenes and pickups.

M5S00_PickupSewerKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the sewer key on map5_s00 (Sewers - lower and upper levels) at map point 29 (x 42.5, z -48.1 m), event 23; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M5S00_DrainKeyAmbushCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the sewer scene with the key in the drain and the ambush of three Hanged Scratchers (map5_s00 Cutscene_DrainKeyAmbush). Afterwards the Sewer Exit Key can be used at point 14, Hanged Scratchers wait in the tunnels and the sewer music adds layers.

M5S00_SewerEntryLadderDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry climbs down the ladder into the sewers when map5_s00 is first entered (MapEvent_SewerLadderDown1).

M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedUp.description: Toggle of the sewer ladder between the lower and upper levels (x = 56.8 m): set (and M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedDown cleared) when Harry climbs up it; the tick event 16 then moves him to the upper level (point 26, FogSewer2F) and sets M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedDown.

M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedDown.description: Toggle of the sewer ladder between the lower and upper levels (x = 56.8 m): set (and M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedUp cleared) when Harry climbs down it; the tick event 18 then moves him to the lower level (point 23, FogSewer1F) and sets M5S00_InnerLadderClimbedUp.

M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedUp.description: Toggle of the sewer ladder up to the Resort Area (x = -22.2 m): set (and M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedDown cleared) when Harry climbs up it; the tick door event 22 then takes him to map5_s01 (point 31) and sets M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedDown.

M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedDown.description: Toggle of the sewer ladder up to the Resort Area (x = -22.2 m): set (and M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedUp, M5S01_SewerEntryFromResortPending cleared) when Harry climbs down it; the tick event 20 then places him at point 27 and sets M5S00_ExitLadderClimbedUp.

M5S01_SewerEntryFromResortPending.description: Set when Harry enters the sewer hatch in the Resort Area (map5_s01 doors at points 2-5 to map5_s00 point 6). On arrival it runs the ladder-down scene of map5_s00 (event 19, MapEvent_SewerLadderDown3), which clears it.

M5S00_PickupMap.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the map on map5_s00 (Sewers - lower and upper levels) at map point 32 (x 41.2, z -49.0 m), event 39; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M5S00_TunnelSoundPlayed.description: One-shot in map5_s00: after the drain key ambush (M5S00_DrainKeyAmbushCutsceneDone), the first time Harry walks south of z = -66 m in the cell x -120..-80 / z -80..-40, a sound plays at (-91.95, 0, -82.2) and the flag is set.

M5S01_PickupMap.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the map on map5_s01 (Resort Area) at map point 25 (x -46.4, z 3.0 m), event 27; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M5S01_DialLockOpened.description: Set when Harry solves the dial lock on the door at map5_s01 point 9 (Puzzle_DialCode). The lock object (FOOK_HID) disappears and the door leads into map5_s02 (point 10).

M5S02_BoxPushed.description: Set when Harry pushes the box at map5_s02 point 6 (PushBox). The Safe Key behind it can then be taken (events 11-13) and the box objects change place.

M5S02_PickupSafeKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the safe key on map5_s02 (Annie's Bar and Indian Runner (Resort Area)) at map point 7 (x 134.7, z 62.1 m), event 11; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M5S02_UsedSafeKey.description: Set when the safe key opens the safe in Annie's Bar / Indian Runner in the resort area (map5_s02, event 15). After that the safe door stays open and inspecting the safe plays the shorter reopen scene (event 14).

M5S02_AnniesBarFirstEntered.description: Completion flag of the first of the two map5_s01 doors at point 7 into Annie's Bar (map5_s02 point 8). It starts the scene of Kaufmann and the Mumbler in the bar (map5_s02 event 4) and sets the bar's music fade.

M5S02_KaufmannBarFightCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Kaufmann shoots the Mumbler in Annie's Bar (map5_s02, POOL1.DMS). It enables the safe with Kaufmann's key and the receipt (event 5) and changes the bar music.

M5S02_PickupKaufmannKeyAndReceipt.description: Set when Harry takes Kaufmann's key and the receipt that Kaufmann dropped in Annie's Bar (map5_s02 KaufmannReceipt). The Kaufmann key can then be used at map5_s01 point 15.

M5S02_BarFightInProgress.description: Set while the Kaufmann/Mumbler fight in Annie's Bar runs (from step 4 until Harry's shot, step 19); the bar's music mix uses it and clears it if it is still set after the scene.

M5S03_PickupMagnet.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the magnet on map5_s03 (Norman's Motel (Resort Area)) at map point 24 (x 61.1, z 18.7 m), event 11; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M5S01_DoorCodePanelSolved.description: Set when Harry enters the right code on the door panel at map5_s01 points 21/22 (Puzzle_DoorCodePanel, DORPANEL.TIM). The door at point 19 then leads into map5_s03 (point 20) and the panel only says 'Nothing unusual.'.

M5S03_DoorToResortUnlocked.description: Set when Harry unlocks the door at map5_s03 point 2 from the inside (MapEvent_DoorUnlocked). The door then leads to the Resort Area (map5_s01 point 3), and the map5_s01 door at point 17 opens into map5_s03 (point 18) instead of being locked.

M5S03_ShelfPushed.description: Set when Harry pushes the shelf in map5_s03 (PushShelf, points 35/36). The crack behind it can then be examined and the motorcycle key fished out with the Magnet (events 12 and 14).

M5S03_PickupMotorcycleKey.description: Set when Harry gets the Motorcycle Key out of the crack with the Magnet in map5_s03 (MotorcycleKeyTake). Afterwards the spot only says 'There's a crack.'.

M5S03_KaufmannHasMotorcycleVial.description: Kaufmann has taken the vial from the motorcycle gas tank: set after the last scene of his side story in the motel (map5_s03). The final boss map (map7_s03) reads it to pick the boss (the Incubus when set, else the Incubator) and, with M6S04_CybilSaved, the ending (Good / Good+ when set, Bad / Bad+ when clear); the music of the final scenes (scripts/map_hooks.lua) follows it too.

M5S03_SeenSecondNewspaper.description: Meant to be set after reading the second newspaper (NEWSP2) in Norman's Motel (map5_s03); it makes the newspaper appear and be readable in Nowhere (map7_s01/map7_s02). The USA 1.1 release never sets it, so its Nowhere newspaper is missing; this port sets it as the PAL and later Japanese releases do.

M5S01_KaufmannKeyUsed.description: Set when the Kaufmann key is used on its door in the resort area (map5_s01, events 22/23, "Used the Kaufmann key."). It enables the door's map transition (event 21).

M5S03_GarageKaufmannPresent.description: Set while Kaufmann is on screen in the garage scene of Norman's Motel (map5_s03 Cutscene_GarageKaufmann, steps 13-27). Only the motel music mix reads it.

M5S02_SafeOpened.description: Set as soon as Harry starts opening the safe in map5_s02 with the Safe Key (UseSafeKey step 0; inside: 'What is this? Drugs?'). One of the three clues (with M5S02_DiaryRead and M5S03_MotelDiaryRead) that make Harry say 'That guy's gotta be involved' in the motel garage scene.

M5S02_DiaryRead.description: Set when Harry reads the diary in map5_s02 (DIARYINR.TIM, 'August 20'). One of the three clues for the motel garage line 'That guy's gotta be involved'.

M5S03_MotelDiaryRead.description: Set when Harry reads the diary in Norman's Motel (map5_s03 MapEvent_MotelDiaryInspect, DIARYMTL.TIM, 'September 10'). One of the three clues for the garage line 'That guy's gotta be involved'.

M5S01_ChannelingStoneUsed.description: Channeling Stone used at the resort area spot (map5_s01 point 39, UFO3.DMS, UFO over the lighthouse). One of the four spots required for the UFO ending.
